title: paeonia corallina subsp. triternata
intro: Paeonia corallina subsp. triternata, commonly known as Paeonia corallina, is a species of flowering plant in the peony family. It is a perennial herb native to China and the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Paeonia corallina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects.
